sloka: कपालपाणिः पृथिवीमटताम् चीरसम्वृतः ।भिक्समाणो यथोन्मत्तो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतह् ॥२-७५-४०॥
transliteration: kapālapāṇiḥ pṛthivīmaṭatām cīrasamvṛtaḥ ।bhiksamāṇo yathonmatto yasyāryo'numate gatah ॥2-75-40॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, wander this earth, begging alms, holding a human skull like an insane man dressed in rags
